newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George-Advance attrition rate three pct.
newsitem.headline: St George-Advance attrition rate three pct.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd, currently completing the merger of its branch network with Advance Bank Ltd, said on Friday its customer attrition rate was still running at less than three percent, well below the seven percent rate it had expected when the merger started in January.
"St.George Bank continues to maintain the merger-related customer attrition rate, well below expectations, at less than three percent," St George said.
St George said in May its attrition rate was running at 2.9 percent.
It also said it had accelerated the conversion of Advance Bank and St George Bank mainframe computer systems to the Group Hogan System (GHS) used by Advance Bank's Bank SA.
St George completed a A$2.635 billion takeover transaction with Advance in January and has forecast total pre-tax cost savings of A$175 million within 30 months of the merger.
